player_0.content: New plan: I incorrectly assumed that the time slots listed in the "We know that" section were the *only* times Hannah was occupied, failing to realize that the gaps between these specific observations represent the potential free time. Specifically, I missed that the period between the last observed activity (reading at the library, 8pm–10pm) and the closing time (10pm) is a valid window, but more importantly, I misidentified the gap between the 11am–3pm observation and the 5pm–8pm observation. The correct window is actually between 3pm and 5pm, which corresponds to Option (D). My error was not systematically checking the boundaries of the provided intervals against the options to find the non-overlapping, valid duration. Next time, I will list all occupied intervals, identify the continuous gaps between them, and verify if any option falls entirely within a gap while respecting the venue's closing time.
